title: Spicy Pepper Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful dish featuring marinated peppers grilled to perfection on skewers.

ingredients.name: red bell peppers
ingredients.notes: any color peppers work, but red adds a nice pop of color

ingredients.name: lovely sweet onions
ingredients.notes: thinly sliced, so they cook quickly

ingredients.name: spicy jalapeños
ingredients.notes: seeded and finely chopped for extra heat

ingredients.name: salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: add to taste, but not too much

instructions: Thread peppers, onions, and jalapeños onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until peppers are tender and lightly charred.
Optional: brush with german mustard during the last minute of grilling.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
